title: Grayton Station Vacation Rental
meta_description: Grayton Station is a 6.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- Parking for 8 Vehicles + Ample Golf Cart Parking- Natural Gas Grill- Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies)- Private Pool (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1-May 1)- Pool House- Child Proof Windows Throughout the Property- Outside Balcony with Gulf Views- Adjacent to The Red Bar- Steps to Sugar White Sands of Grayton Beach DETAILS:Located in the heart of Grayton Beach, just steps from the sandy shores and the iconic Red Bar, a stunning six-bedroom home awaits to welcome you and your loved ones at "Grayton Station". This charming and unique property comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests—and it's pet-friendly too! Inside, vibrant hand-painted folk art creates an inviting atmosphere throughout the residence. Ascend to the second floor, where intricate doors and captivating art greet you. The expansive dining area, featuring two tables and a bar, comfortably seats up to 20—perfect for delightful meals and lively games. The funky kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances and a seafood boiler kit, is ideal for memorable cookouts. The cozy living area offers breathtaking beach views through patio doors, while the luxurious master bedroom features a king-size bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. Venture to the third floor, adorned with colorful paintings and four additional bedrooms, including two king suites, a queen room, and a playful bunk room. This level also includes a wet bar, laundry area, and twin trundle bed, with a balcony inviting you to relax and soak in stunning sunset views. Outside, indulge in your private pool, complete with ample seating for sunbathing and swimming. The pool house features a full kitchen, laundry area, bath with a walk-in shower, and versatile sleeping options, including a trundle bed and king murphy bed. At "Grayton Station", 255 Garfield Street, luxury and laid-back beach living blend seamlessly, creating the perfect backdrop for an unforgettable vacation. Experience all that Grayton Beach has to offer, where cherished memories await around every corner.
